entities.summary: Christian David Hanson is an American former professional ice hockey player who played for the Toronto Maple Leafs in the NHL. Hanson played college hockey for the University of Notre Dame. He was not selected in the NHL Entry Draft but signed a contract as a free agent with the Maple Leafs after his senior season.
